purpose: Determine whether the front-side depth-withdrawal requirement is a causal confirmation or only a frequency-reducing noisy filter after the unchanged candidate passed week 1 and failed locked week 2.

ablation.implementation: Set maximum_front_depth_change to 1000000.0 so no finite completed-minute depth change is rejected; do not alter signal direction, flow persistence, turnover, price-impact, accepted-range, stop, target, holding time, costs, or risk.
ablation.why_this_variable: It is the least structurally stable element across venues and weeks, while the observed second-week failure combined both inadequate frequency and poor expectancy. Removing it directly tests whether it supplied predictive information or merely suppressed opportunities.

decision_rule: A structural improvement path exists only if the same ablated rule passes every gate in both already revealed weeks. Otherwise discard v77, record the failure and useful components, and move to a new causal hypothesis. This diagnostic cannot itself be promoted as blind evidence.
